title: Stasis Boss Fight
description: A paused video game scene shows a blue dragon-like sorcerer with a glowing staff confronting a golden serpentine dragon on stone steps before a massive skull-adorned archway. To the right, a green armored warrior with a glowing blue sword stands on a floating platform, while a bandaged mummy-like creature reaches toward the action. The screen displays 'PAUSED' and 'STASIS 100%' at the top.
prompt: A vibrant fantasy battle scene set against a swirling purple and teal cosmic background with floating runes. In the foreground, a blue-skinned dragon sorcerer in ornate black and gold robes holds a glowing staff, standing beside a massive golden Chinese-style dragon on broken stone stairs. A giant demonic skull archway covered in golden snakes looms behind them. To the right, a muscular green armored warrior holds a glowing blue sword while standing on a floating stone platform, facing a screaming bandaged mummy creature with purple wrappings. The image has a video game UI overlay showing 'PAUSED' in large pink letters and 'STASIS 100%' in green.
